stem: Which long-term health benefit is supported by current CDC guidance on regular physical activity for adults?

options.A: It lowers the risk of heart disease, stroke, and type 2 diabetes
options.B: It increases the long-term risk of type 2 diabetes
options.C: Its established benefits are limited to muscle appearance
options.D: It has no established effect on chronic-disease risk

rationale: CDC states that regular physical activity lowers the risk of heart disease, stroke, and type 2 diabetes; it also provides other immediate and long-term health benefits.
educational_objective: Recognize evidence-based chronic-disease benefits of regular physical activity.
source_document_title: Health Benefits of Physical Activity for Adults
source_claim_supported: Regular physical activity lowers the risk of heart disease, stroke, and type 2 diabetes.
blueprint_locator: 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan, Health Promotion and Maintenance, printed p.9 / PDF p.13
correction_summary: Narrowed the broad multi-claim source item to one exact current CDC long-term benefit statement.
audit_findings: A is directly stated by CDC. B–D contradict the cited guidance. No second answer remains.
audit_reviewer: GPT-5.6 Sol Rule 1 — final semantic audit
